AccountDelete.description: Deleting your own account: the password again, so a session left open can't do it.
AccountDelete.title: AccountDelete

Activity.description:
Completed answers per local day, from `start` (a Monday) to `end` (the Sunday of the
current week). Days after `today` are in the future, not missed.
Activity.title: Activity

AdminUserUpdate.description: Omitted: unchanged. A limit set to null goes back to the server default.
AdminUserUpdate.title: AdminUserUpdate

Announcement.description: A message from the author to everyone who has the course, without a new version.
Announcement.title: Announcement

BulkItemAction.description: One action on many Learning Items of a Course (all or nothing).
BulkItemAction.title: BulkItemAction

ConsolidationPlan.description:
What "I have studied this concept" would start, shown before starting (items, rounds,
answers), or the unfinished batch it would resume.
ConsolidationPlan.title: ConsolidationPlan

Conversation.description: A chat with one friend, in the list of chats.
Conversation.title: Conversation

CourseCard.description:
One course in the library. Every figure is a count with its own denominator; none of
them is mastery (docs/XP_AND_ACTIVITY.md §7).
CourseCard.title: CourseCard

CourseOrigin.description: On a course reached through the marketplace.
CourseOrigin.title: CourseOrigin

CurriculumApply.description:
The curriculum as the user accepted it: renamed, reordered, merged, split, moved or with
items deleted, all expressed by sending the edited tree (docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §20).
`chapters` for a Course proposal, `topics` for a Chapter proposal: exactly one.
CurriculumApply.title: CurriculumApply

CurriculumDelete.description: Whole groups and single questions to delete together (the question manager's selection).
CurriculumDelete.title: CurriculumDelete

CurriculumDeleteResult.description:
What was selected and removed. Anything inside a selected group goes with it and is not
counted separately.
CurriculumDeleteResult.title: CurriculumDeleteResult

CurriculumProgress.description:
How far through the material the user is (study states, spec §22). Says nothing about
memory.
CurriculumProgress.title: CurriculumProgress

CurriculumProposalStatus.description:
AI curriculum proposal lifecycle (docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §20). Nothing reaches the Course
until the user applies a READY proposal.
CurriculumProposalStatus.title: CurriculumProposalStatus

DiscountQuote.description: What a code does to a listing's price, before paying.
DiscountQuote.title: DiscountQuote

DocumentKind.description: File types the Knowledge Repository accepts (docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §16).
DocumentKind.title: DocumentKind

DocumentPurpose.description:
What an upload is. MATERIAL is study material the AI builds a curriculum from; a
QUESTION_BANK holds the user's own labelled questions and expected answers, imported as they
are, without AI.
DocumentPurpose.title: DocumentPurpose

DocumentStatus.description:
Ingestion pipeline state (docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §17). FAILED documents stay stored, with a
user-safe reason, so nothing the user uploaded silently disappears.
DocumentStatus.title: DocumentStatus

DocumentUpdate.description:
Files the document under a Chapter of the same Course, or unassigns it (null). Moving it
marks it not analyzed, so its material is analyzed again in its new Chapter.
DocumentUpdate.title: DocumentUpdate

ExamPlan.description: With an exam date on the course: what it takes to get there.
ExamPlan.title: ExamPlan

HomeSummary.description:
The signed-in user's day, per Course. `totals` sums the Courses' review loads; nothing
else is combined across Courses.
HomeSummary.title: HomeSummary

Inbox.description: The counts behind the badges, polled by the app.
Inbox.title: Inbox

Introduction.description: LEARN only: what to encode, shown before the first retrieval.
Introduction.title: Introduction

InvitationCreated.description: Returned once, at creation: the code can't be read back afterwards.
InvitationCreated.title: InvitationCreated

ItemGenerationStatus.description: Learning Item generation for one Concept (background job, like curriculum proposals).
ItemGenerationStatus.title: ItemGenerationStatus

LearnAction.description:
What the course's Learn button does. resume: an unfinished consolidation batch;
study: open the next concept with material waiting ("I have studied this concept" is
there); activate: the next concept needs activating first; setup: the course has no
concepts yet (add material or questions); none: everything has been learned.
LearnAction.title: LearnAction

LearningItemCreate.description: A Learning Item the user writes by hand, e.g. for a Concept with no source material.
LearningItemCreate.title: LearningItemCreate

LearningItemRole.description:
What a Learning Item is for (docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §24). The AI suggests a role; whether
the item is actually trained is the separate, user-controlled `in_training` flag.
LearningItemRole.title: LearningItemRole

ListingInfo.description:
The course's sales page, written by its author: all a buyer sees before getting access,
with the chapter titles and question counts. Editable at any time, published or not.
ListingInfo.title: ListingInfo

MemoryProgress.description:
How well the trained material is retained (spec §23, §52). `mastery` is an estimate
(0-1), not a measurement: the mean over trained items of level / top level, discounted
for lapses. Null when nothing is trained yet.
MemoryProgress.title: MemoryProgress

MemoryRead.description: The item's memory state (spec §23, §48). Read-only: only the SchedulingPolicy moves it.
MemoryRead.title: MemoryRead

MemoryState.description:
Memory state of a Learning Item (docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §23). Owned by the
SchedulingPolicy; never the Concept's.
MemoryState.title: MemoryState

OrderUpdate.description: A parent's children in their new order (drag and drop): every child exactly once.
OrderUpdate.title: OrderUpdate

PayoutStatus.description: Whether the viewer can sell paid courses.
PayoutStatus.title: PayoutStatus

Person.description: A listed person: a friend, someone in a friend request, or a search result.
Person.title: Person

PotentialXp.description:
What a correct answer to this card would earn, decided by the server (never sent back
by the client). Not eligible: learning with the answer shown, practice, a review of an item
that isn't due, or an item past its three XP-eligible consolidation rounds.
PotentialXp.title: PotentialXp

ProposalSource.description:
Where a proposed Concept came from; open it with
GET /documents/{document_id}/chunks/{chunk_id}.
ProposalSource.title: ProposalSource

QuestionGenerate.description: Ask the AI for more formulations of one Learning Item (spec §27-29).
QuestionGenerate.title: QuestionGenerate

Redirect.description: An address on the payment provider's site to send the browser to.
Redirect.title: Redirect

Reference.description: The correct answer and where it comes from, shown with the feedback (spec §41, §66).
Reference.title: Reference

Relation.description: What another person is to the viewer.
Relation.title: Relation

RepeatCreate.description: The answer written again after reviewing the reference.
RepeatCreate.title: RepeatCreate

ReportRead.description:
What the administrator sees: who reported, about whom, and the reported text itself
(copied when the report was made).
ReportRead.title: ReportRead

ReviewLoad.description:
Upcoming reviews of items that can be reviewed now (active, trained, not paused), by the
user's calendar day. Buckets don't overlap: everything due today is due_now + later_today.
ReviewLoad.title: ReviewLoad

ReviewOutcome.description:
docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §46. Decided by the ReviewOutcomeResolver (or the user's override),
never by the AI directly.
ReviewOutcome.title: ReviewOutcome

SelectionMode.description: How a session's pool is chosen (docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §49), independent of intent.
SelectionMode.title: SelectionMode

SessionIntent.description: What a session is for, pedagogically. Decides whether answers touch the schedule.
SessionIntent.title: SessionIntent

StudyState.description: docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md §22 — does NOT represent memory strength.
StudyState.title: StudyState

WeakSpots.description:
Misconceptions the evaluator keeps finding, by concept: the last few evaluations of each
item, so something fixed stops showing once it has been answered correctly.
WeakSpots.title: WeakSpots

XpReason.description: Why an attempt was (or wasn't) worth XP (docs/XP_AND_ACTIVITY.md).
XpReason.title: XpReason

XpResult.description: The XP decision for this answer, made once when it was first finalized.
XpResult.title: XpResult

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

post.description:
For someone who lost their password and has no working email link: a new random password,
shown once. Every session of that account ends. They should change it after signing in.
A second opinion: the evaluator sees the student's objection. Changes no grade.

get.description: The drawing given as this answer (owner only).

post.description: Evaluates again after a failed (or unconfigured) attempt.
The user's own grade. Keeps the AI evaluation; see docs/API.md for replay rules.

Review the reference answer and repeat it (409 `repeat_not_offered` otherwise). The
repeat is evaluated: repeated well, the first answer counts as correct; not well, it is
failed and the item goes back to level 0.

Needs the current password (422 `wrong_password`). Ends every other session and returns
a fresh token for this one.

Deletes the account for good, with everything it owns: courses, uploaded files, answers,
XP, friendships, messages, reviews and the courses it published (people who already have
one keep their copy). Needs the password (422 `wrong_password`). The only administrator
can't leave (409 `last_admin`): the site would have nobody to run it.

get.description: A copy of everything held about the account, as a JSON file to download.

patch.description:
Profile and preferences: display name, interface language, timezone, daily goal. A new
timezone applies from now on: days already recorded keep the date they were recorded under
(docs/XP_AND_ACTIVITY.md §5).

post.description:
Sets the new password from a valid link (422 `invalid_reset_token` otherwise). Every
existing session of the account ends; sign in again with the new password.

"Forgot your password?". Always the same 202 answer, whether or not the email has an
account, so it can't be used to find out who is registered. At most 3 links per account per
hour; each link works once, for PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES, and retires the older ones.

Activating a Concept with sources and no Learning Items yet also starts generating them
in the background (`item_generation_status: GENERATING`).

waiting. Answer it through the usual review-session endpoints.

the Concept or its item list. Activation starts it automatically when possible.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Documents Get

post.description:
Stores the file and returns immediately (202) with status PROCESSING; poll
GET /documents/{id} until it is READY or FAILED. Optional form field `chapter_id` files it
under a Chapter of this Course.

Form field `purpose`: MATERIAL (default) is study material for curriculum generation.
QUESTION_BANK holds the user's own questions and expected answers, labelled "Domanda:" /
"Risposta:" (or "Question:" / "Answer:"). Each pair becomes a NOT_STUDIED Concept with one
Learning Item, under `chapter_id` or a new Chapter named after the file.

put.description:
The day of the exam (null removes it): the progress page then says how many new
questions a day get there.

get.description: Every Learning Item of the Course with its questions, in course order.

schema.title: Response List Course Items Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Learning Items Get

post.description:
Delete, pause, resume or move many items at once; all or nothing (404 if any id isn't one
of this Course's items). Moving keeps each item's memory state and history.
The author writes to everyone who has the course (at most 5 a day).

Everything the dashboard shows, in the user's timezone and against one `as_of` time:

get.description:
The original file, to its owner only (404 for anyone else, as for a missing id). Always
an attachment, never rendered inline, so an uploaded HTML or SVG can't run in the app's
origin. There are no public or pre-signed URLs: every download passes this check.

The Home screen in one call: each of the user's Courses with its review load, active
Concepts, mastery estimate and weakest Concepts.
The counts behind the app's badges.
The tags the user follows, and tags of published courses they could follow.

AI-written new formulations of this item, from its own passages (201, the new ones).
409 when the item has no sources or they aren't enough; 503/502 on AI failure.

Deletes one wording (409 `last_question` for the item's only one: delete the item).
Answers given to it go too, drawn ones with their files.

patch.description: Rewords one question; its item's memory state is kept.

post.description: Tell the administrator about a person, a message you received or a review.

Stores the answer, evaluates it, resolves the outcome and applies it. Always 201 once
the answer is stored, even if evaluation failed (`needs_self_grade`). A drawing question
takes `drawing` (a PNG/JPEG/WebP data URL) instead of `text`.

Reveals the hint for the current question. Stored before it is returned: the answer to
this question earns half XP, whatever the client does next. 409 `hint_unavailable` when the
question has no hint (nothing is recorded then).
